question: If it 【A will rain】 tomorrow, we 【B will put off】 【C the picnic】 【D until】 next Sunday.
choices: A will rain|B will put off|C the picnic|D until
explanation: A → rains。時・条件を表す副詞節（if / when など）の中では、未来のことでも現在形を使う。

question: She 【A is】 【B enough old】 【C to】 【D travel】 abroad alone.
choices: A is|B enough old|C to|D travel
explanation: B → old enough。enough は形容詞・副詞の「後ろ」に置く：形容詞 + enough to 〜

question: I 【A saw】 a boy 【B to cross】 the street 【C while】 the light 【D was】 red.
choices: A saw|B to cross|C while|D was
explanation: B → crossing（または cross）。知覚動詞 see + O + 〜ing / 原形。to はつけない。

question: My mother 【A didn't】 let me 【B to go】 out 【C after】 dark 【D last night】.
choices: A didn't|B to go|C after|D last night
explanation: B → go。使役動詞 let + O + 動詞の原形。to はつけない。

question: The question was 【A such】 difficult 【B that】 【C none of us】 【D could answer】 it.
choices: A such|B that|C none of us|D could answer
explanation: A → so。so + 形容詞 + that 〜（とても…なので〜）。such は such a difficult question のように名詞が続くとき。

question: 【A Because】 the heavy snow, the trains 【B were】 【C delayed】 【D for】 two hours.
choices: A Because|B were|C delayed|D for
explanation: A → Because of。because の後ろは「文（主語＋動詞）」、because of の後ろは「名詞」。

question: 【A During】 I was staying in Kyoto, I 【B visited】 【C a lot of】 temples 【D with】 my aunt.
choices: A During|B visited|C a lot of|D with
explanation: A → While。during は前置詞（後ろに名詞）、while は接続詞（後ろに文）。

question: This is a picture 【A painting】 【B by】 a famous artist 【C who】 【D lived】 in France.
choices: A painting|B by|C who|D lived
explanation: A → painted。「〜によって描かれた絵」は過去分詞の後置修飾：a picture painted by 〜

question: Tom 【A has gone】 to Canada 【B three times】, so he knows 【C a lot about】 【D the country】.
choices: A has gone|B three times|C a lot about|D the country
explanation: A → has been。「〜に行ったことがある（経験）」は have been to。have gone to は「行ってしまって今ここにいない」。

question: I 【A am looking forward】 to 【B see】 you 【C again】 【D soon】.
choices: A am looking forward|B see|C again|D soon
explanation: B → seeing。look forward to の to は前置詞なので、後ろは動名詞（〜ing）。

question: The number of tourists 【A who visit】 Japan 【B are】 【C increasing】 【D every year】.
choices: A who visit|B are|C increasing|D every year
explanation: B → is。主語は The number（数）なので単数扱い。A number of 〜（たくさんの〜）なら複数扱い。

question: My father 【A insisted】 that I 【B went】 to the doctor 【C at once】 【D because】 I had a fever.
choices: A insisted|B went|C at once|D because
explanation: B → (should) go。insist / suggest / demand that 〜 で「〜すべきだと要求する」ときは、that 節の動詞は原形（または should + 原形）。

question: 【A Hardly】 had I 【B arrived】 at the station 【C than】 the train 【D left】.
choices: A Hardly|B arrived|C than|D left
explanation: C → when（または before）。Hardly had S 過去分詞 when 〜（〜するとすぐに…）。than を使うのは No sooner … than。

question: It is 【A no use】 【B to cry】 over 【C spilt】 milk, 【D as】 the saying goes.
choices: A no use|B to cry|C spilt|D as
explanation: B → crying。It is no use 〜ing（〜しても無駄だ）。「覆水盆に返らず」ということわざ。

question: The climate 【A of】 Tokyo 【B is】 milder 【C than】 【D Sapporo】.
choices: A of|B is|C than|D Sapporo
explanation: D → that of Sapporo。比べているのは「東京の気候」と「札幌の気候」。同じ名詞のくり返しを that（複数なら those）で表す。

question: I don't know 【A what】 【B does】 this word 【C mean】 【D in】 English.
choices: A what|B does|C mean|D in
explanation: B → 不要（what this word means）。間接疑問は「疑問詞＋主語＋動詞」の語順で、does は使わない。

question: 【A Each】 of the students 【B have】 【C their own】 tablet 【D at】 this school.
choices: A Each|B have|C their own|D at
explanation: B → has。Each of 〜 は単数扱い。

question: He is too young to drive a car. ＝ He is not old (    ) to drive a car.
explanation: too 〜 to …（〜すぎて…できない）＝ not 〜 enough to …。反対の意味の形容詞を使う（young ↔ old）。

question: I don't have a smartphone, so I can't call her. ＝ If I (    ) a smartphone, I could call her.
explanation: 仮定法過去：If + 主語 + 過去形, 主語 + would / could + 原形（現在の事実と反対の仮定）。

question: She started living here five years ago. ＝ She has (    ) here for five years.
explanation: 現在完了（継続）：have / has + 過去分詞 + for 〜（〜の間）。

question: Shall we go shopping? ＝ (    ) don't we go shopping?
explanation: Why don't we 〜? ＝ Shall we 〜? ＝ Let's 〜.（〜しませんか）

question: Mt. Fuji is the highest mountain in Japan. ＝ Mt. Fuji is higher than any (    ) mountain in Japan.
explanation: 比較級 + than any other + 単数名詞 ＝ 最上級の意味。other を忘れやすい。

question: This is the house which my grandfather built. ＝ This is the house (    ) by my grandfather.
explanation: 関係代名詞 → 過去分詞の後置修飾：the house built by 〜（〜によって建てられた家）。

question: Nobody in my class runs as fast as Ken. ＝ Ken runs the (    ) in my class.
explanation: Nobody … as 〜 as A ＝ A が一番〜。副詞の最上級 the fastest。

question: I was very tired, so I couldn't walk any more. ＝ I was (    ) tired to walk any more.
explanation: so 〜 that 主語 can't … ＝ too 〜 to …（〜すぎて…できない）。

question: Do you know her address? ＝ Do you know (    ) she lives?
explanation: 間接疑問：Do you know where she lives?（疑問詞＋主語＋動詞の語順）

question: My uncle gave me this watch. ＝ This watch was (    ) to me by my uncle.
explanation: 受動態：be + 過去分詞。give - gave - given。物が主語のときは to me が必要。

question: It's a pity that I can't speak French. ＝ I (    ) I could speak French.
explanation: I wish + 仮定法過去：「〜ならいいのに」（現在の事実に反する願望）。

question: Remember to lock the door. ＝ Don't (    ) to lock the door.
explanation: remember to 〜（忘れずに〜する）＝ don't forget to 〜。

question: Walking every day is good for your health. ＝ It is good for your health (    ) walk every day.
explanation: 動名詞の主語 → It is 〜 to …（形式主語 it）。

question: He said, "I will help you." ＝ He said that he (    ) help me.
explanation: 時制の一致：said（過去）に合わせて will → would。代名詞も I → he、you → me に変わる。

question: Rising sea levels may ( l    ) to serious floods in the future. （〜につながる）
explanation: lead to 〜（〜につながる・〜を引き起こす）。lead - led - led

question: You should take her age into ( a    ) when you choose a present. （考慮に入れる）
explanation: take 〜 into account（〜を考慮に入れる）。

question: The temple was built 300 years ago, but it is still well ( p    ). （保存されている）
explanation: be well preserved（よく保存されている）。be + well + 過去分詞の語順。

question: Food prices continue to ( r    ) every year. （上がる）
explanation: rise（自動詞：上がる）rise - rose - risen。raise は他動詞（〜を上げる）なので目的語が必要。

question: Everyone came to the party ( e    ) Mike. He was sick in bed. （〜を除いて）
explanation: except（〜を除いて）。except for 〜 の形もある。

question: Many Japanese immigrants ( f    ) discrimination in America in the early 1900s. （〜に直面した）
explanation: face（〜に直面する）。過去の話なので faced。

question: This bridge is about three times (    ) that one.
choices: as long as|as longer as|long as|longer as
explanation: X times as 〜 as …（…のX倍〜）。as と as の間は原級。

question: This is by (    ) the most interesting book I have ever read.
choices: far|much|very|more
explanation: 最上級の強調は by far（ずばぬけて）。比較級の強調は much / far。

question: Japan's population is larger than (    ) of Germany.
choices: that|this|it|one
explanation: 比べるのは「日本の人口」と「ドイツの人口」。the population のくり返しを that で表す。

question: Not until I lost my health (    ) how important it was.
choices: did I realize|I realized|I did realize|realized I
explanation: Not until 〜 が文頭に来ると倒置（did + 主語 + 原形）。「健康を失って初めてその大切さに気づいた」

question: If I (    ) you, I would accept the offer.
choices: were|am|will be|have been
explanation: 仮定法過去では be 動詞は主語に関係なく were が基本。

question: If it (    ) for your help, I would have failed the exam.
choices: had not been|were not|is not|has not been
explanation: 仮定法過去完了：If it had not been for 〜（もし〜がなかったら〔過去〕）。

question: She is the last person (    ) tell a lie.
choices: to|who|that|for
explanation: the last person to 〜（最も〜しそうにない人＝決して〜しない人）。

question: There are many old buildings in this town, some of (    ) were built 200 years ago.
choices: which|them|that|what
explanation: コンマ + some of which（そのうちのいくつかは）。them だと文が2つつながらない。that はコンマの後で使えない。

question: The town (    ) I grew up has changed a lot.
choices: where|which|what|who
explanation: grow up in the town → 場所を表す関係副詞 where（= in which）。

question: I have two brothers. One lives in Osaka, and (    ) lives in Tokyo.
choices: the other|another|other|the others
explanation: 2つ（2人）のうち、1つは one、残りの1つは the other。

question: (    ) from the plane, the island looked like a heart.
choices: Seen|Seeing|To see|Saw
explanation: 分詞構文。島は「見られる」側なので過去分詞 Seen（= When it was seen）。

question: Would you mind (    ) the window?
choices: opening|to open|open|opened
explanation: mind は動名詞を目的語にとる。Would you mind 〜ing?（〜していただけませんか）

question: He is used to (    ) up early.
choices: getting|get|got|be getting
explanation: be used to 〜ing（〜するのに慣れている）。used to + 原形（以前は〜したものだ）と区別。

question: I'll lend you this book (    ) you return it by Friday.
choices: as long as|unless|though|until
explanation: as long as 〜（〜する限り・〜しさえすれば）。条件を表す。

question: Hurry up, (    ) you'll miss the bus.
choices: or|and|but|so
explanation: 命令文 + or 〜（さもないと〜）。命令文 + and 〜 は「そうすれば〜」。

question: Children today are exposed (    ) a lot of information on the Internet.
choices: to|with|by|for
explanation: be exposed to 〜（〜にさらされる・触れる）。

question: The heavy rain prevented us (    ) going out.
choices: from|to|of|with
explanation: prevent A from 〜ing（A が〜するのを妨げる）。keep / stop A from 〜ing も同じ形。

question: Our team is likely (    ) the game.
choices: to win|winning|win|won
explanation: be likely to 〜（〜しそうだ）。

question: 彼が何について話しているのか、私にはさっぱりわからない。
answer: I have no idea what he is talking about.
explanation: 間接疑問：what + 主語 + 動詞。talk about の about が最後に残る。

question: この本は難しすぎて私には読めない。
answer: This book is too difficult for me to read.
explanation: too 〜 for 人 to …（〜すぎて人は…できない）。

question: 窓のそばに立っている少女は私の妹です。
answer: The girl standing by the window is my sister.
explanation: 現在分詞の後置修飾：the girl standing by the window。

question: もっと時間があれば、世界中を旅するのに。
answer: If I had more time, I would travel around the world.
explanation: 仮定法過去：If + 過去形, would + 原形。

question: その知らせを聞いて、私たちはとても驚いた。
answer: We were very surprised to hear the news.
explanation: 感情の原因の不定詞：be surprised to 〜（〜して驚く）。

question: 駅への行き方を教えていただけませんか。
answer: Could you tell me how to get to the station?
explanation: how to 〜（〜のしかた）。Could you 〜? はていねいな依頼。

question: 私が昨日買った本はとてもおもしろい。
answer: The book I bought yesterday is very interesting.
explanation: 関係代名詞（目的格）の省略：the book (which) I bought yesterday。

question: 母は私に皿洗いを手伝ってくれるよう頼んだ。
answer: My mother asked me to help her with the dishes.
explanation: ask 人 to 〜（人に〜するよう頼む）、help 人 with 物（人の物を手伝う）。

question: 英語を話すことは、あなたが思っているほど難しくない。
answer: Speaking English is not as difficult as you think.
explanation: 動名詞の主語 Speaking English、not as 〜 as …（…ほど〜でない）。

question: 彼は私が今まで会った中で最も親切な人です。
answer: He is the kindest person I have ever met.
explanation: 最上級 + (that) I have ever 過去分詞（今まで〜した中で一番…）。

question: contribute
choices: 貢献する|分配する|比較する|拒否する
explanation: contribute to 〜（〜に貢献する・〜の一因となる）。contribution（貢献）

question: discrimination
choices: 差別|発見|議論|分配
explanation: discrimination = 差別。discriminate（差別する）

question: essential
choices: 不可欠な|補助的な|伝統的な|一時的な
explanation: essential = 不可欠な・本質的な。necessary より強い。

question: generation
choices: 世代|政府|将来|人口
explanation: generation = 世代。the second generation（二世）

question: likely
choices: 〜しそうな|愛らしい|そっくりの|生き生きした
explanation: be likely to 〜（〜しそうだ）。lovely（愛らしい）、alike（似ている）、lively（生き生きした）と区別。

question: immigrant
choices: 移民|観光客|留学生|難民
explanation: immigrant = （外国からの）移民。「難民」は refugee。

question: consequence
choices: 結果|原因|目的|条件
explanation: consequence = 結果・影響。as a consequence（その結果）

question: ancestor
choices: 祖先|子孫|親類|隣人
explanation: ancestor = 祖先。「子孫」は descendant。

question: prevent
choices: 防ぐ・妨げる|予言する|提供する|保護する
explanation: prevent A from 〜ing（A が〜するのを妨げる）。

question: participate
choices: 参加する|分割する|祝う|期待する
explanation: participate in 〜 = take part in 〜（〜に参加する）。

question: 〜を避ける
explanation: avoid 〜ing（〜するのを避ける）。後ろは動名詞。

question: 〜を減らす
explanation: reduce = 減らす。reduce CO2 emissions（二酸化炭素の排出を減らす）

question: 結論
explanation: conclusion = 結論。draw a conclusion（結論を出す）、in conclusion（結論として）

question: 証拠
explanation: evidence = 証拠。数えられない名詞。

question: 多様性
explanation: diversity = 多様性。diverse（多様な）

question: 〜に頼る
explanation: depend on 〜 / rely on 〜（〜に頼る）。

question: 自信
explanation: confidence = 自信。confident（自信のある）

question: 〜を要求する
explanation: demand / require / request（要求する）。demand that 〜 の that 節は原形（should）。

question: We discussed about the problem for an hour.
explanation: discuss は他動詞なので前置詞は不要：discuss the problem。

question: She married with a doctor last year.
explanation: marry は他動詞：marry 人（人と結婚する）。get married to 人 の形もある。

question: Please let me to know your plans.
explanation: 使役動詞 let + O + 原形。to は不要。

question: When did you reach to the station?
explanation: reach は他動詞：reach the station。arrive at / get to と区別。

question: He entered into the room quietly.
explanation: enter は他動詞：enter the room（部屋に入る）。

question: This is the house which I lived in it as a child.
explanation: 関係代名詞 which が in の目的語の役割をしているので it は不要。

question: I have never been seen such a beautiful sunset.
explanation: 「見たことがない」は能動の現在完了 have never seen。been があると受け身になってしまう。

question: The man who he is standing over there is my uncle.
explanation: 関係代名詞 who が主語の役割をしているので he は不要。

question: Let's go to shopping this afternoon.
explanation: go shopping（買い物に行く）。go 〜ing に to は不要。

question: How about to going to the movies tonight?
explanation: How about 〜ing?（〜するのはどうですか）。about の直後に to は不要。

question: I don't know what does this word mean.
explanation: 間接疑問は「疑問詞＋主語＋動詞」：what this word means。does は不要。

question: My brother is more taller than my father.
explanation: taller はすでに比較級。more taller とは言わない。

question: Each of the students has their own a computer.
explanation: own の前に所有格（their）があるので a は不要：their own computer。

question: Please tell me the reason why for you were late.
explanation: the reason why + 主語 + 動詞。for は不要。

question: The news made us to feel happy.
explanation: 使役 make + O + 原形：made us feel happy。

question: I was very surprised at to hear the news.
explanation: be surprised to 〜（〜して驚く）。be surprised at + 名詞 と混ぜない。

question: If I were you, I would not to do that.
explanation: 助動詞 would の後は原形：would not do。

question: 次のうち、文法的に正しい英文はどれ？（lie / lay）
choices: He laid on the bed and soon fell asleep.|He lay on the bed and soon fell asleep.|He lied on the bed and soon fell asleep.|He was lain on the bed and soon fell asleep.
answer: He lay on the bed and soon fell asleep.
explanation: lie（横になる）- lay - lain、lay（〜を置く・横たえる）- laid - laid。「横になった」は lay。lied は「うそをついた」。

question: 次のうち、文法的に正しい英文はどれ？（rise / raise）
choices: The sun raises in the east.|Please rise your hand if you know the answer.|Prices have risen sharply this year.|The teacher was risen her voice.
answer: Prices have risen sharply this year.
explanation: rise（上がる・自動詞）- rose - risen、raise（〜を上げる・他動詞）- raised - raised。

question: 次のうち、文法的に正しい英文はどれ？（say / tell）
choices: She said me that she was busy.|She told to me that she was busy.|She told me that she was busy.|She talked me that she was busy.
answer: She told me that she was busy.
explanation: tell + 人 + that 〜。say は say to 人 / say that 〜 で、say me とは言わない。talk は that 節をとらない。

question: 次のうち、文法的に正しい英文はどれ？（borrow / lend）
choices: Can you borrow me your pen?|Can I borrow your pen for a minute?|Can I lend your pen for a minute?|I borrowed my bike to Tom yesterday.
answer: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
explanation: borrow（借りる）、lend（貸す）：lend 人 物 / lend 物 to 人。

question: 次のうち、文法的に正しい英文はどれ？（動詞と前置詞）
choices: We discussed about the plan.|She married with an American.|They arrived to Tokyo at noon.|I'll attend the meeting tomorrow.
explanation: attend（出席する）は他動詞。discuss / marry も他動詞なので about / with は不要。arrive は arrive in / at。

question: 次のうち、文法的に正しい英文はどれ？（数えられない名詞）
choices: I have many homework today.|She gave me some good advices.|We need more information about it.|How many furnitures do you have?
answer: We need more information about it.
explanation: information / homework / advice / furniture は数えられない名詞。many や -s をつけない。

question: 次のうち、文法的に正しい英文はどれ？（現在完了）
choices: I have seen him yesterday.|When have you finished your homework?|I have known her since we were children.|He has died three years ago.
answer: I have known her since we were children.
explanation: 現在完了は yesterday / ago / When 〜? など過去の一時点を表す語と一緒に使えない。since 〜（〜以来）はOK。

question: 次のうち、文法的に正しい英文はどれ？（比較）
choices: He is very taller than me.|She is the more beautiful of the three.|Tokyo is larger than any city in Japan.|This is the most expensive of all the bags.
answer: This is the most expensive of all the bags.
explanation: 比較級の強調は much（very は不可）。any city ではなく any other city。3人の比較は最上級 the most。

question: 次のうち、文法的に正しい英文はどれ？（感情を表す分詞）
choices: I was very exciting about the trip.|The movie was very bored.|Everyone was surprised at the news.|I am interesting in science.
answer: Everyone was surprised at the news.
explanation: 人が「〜させられる」→ 過去分詞（surprised / excited / interested）、物が「〜させる」→ 現在分詞（exciting / boring）。

question: 次のうち、文法的に正しい英文はどれ？（by / until）
choices: I'll finish it until tomorrow.|I'll wait here by five o'clock.|Please hand in your report by Friday.|He was born at 2011.
answer: Please hand in your report by Friday.
explanation: by（〜までに：期限）、until（〜までずっと：継続）。年の前は in：in 2011。

question: 次のうち、文法的に正しい英文はどれ？（間接疑問）
choices: I don't know where does he live.|Can you tell me what time it is?|Do you know who is she?|I wonder what did she buy.
answer: Can you tell me what time it is?
explanation: 間接疑問は「疑問詞＋主語＋動詞」の語順。what time it is が正しい。

question: 次のうち、文法的に正しい英文はどれ？（hear / listen / look / see）
